messages:
Carla R.: Quick nudge on PM-2026-256 remediations 99we need a short closure/status snapshot for the weekly L3 digest. Please post one-line updates.

Carla R.: Actions excerpt from the doc:
```
A1 - reduce request queue mem cap and add graceful drop (owner: Ethan V.) - due 2026-04-01
A2 - implement model-fallback policy and test canary (owner: Ravi S.) - due 2026-03-30
A3 - add eviction-rate alert and annotate runbook (owner: Maya K.) - due 2026-03-29
A4 - consolidate postmortem notes into runbook and add TL;DR (owner: unassigned) - due 2026-04-05
```

Ethan V.: A1: config PR up https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/runtime/pull/1155. Need perf bench to pass; queued. ETA if bench green: 2026-04-02.

Ravi S.: A2: canary failed yesterday due to unrelated infra throttle. Re-ran canary with reduced qps; passed. Planning full rollout tomorrow morning. Marking as in-progress -> canary-passed.

Maya K.: A3: alert added to staging, ran 72h check. Two minor false positives that were labeling issues; tuned and re-deployed. Marking as verifying.

SRE Bot: :warning: Action A1 is 1 day past due. Owner: Ethan V.

Carla R.: Ethan please post an ETA by EOD. If perf bench hangs again we'll need a mitigation (temporary lower mem cap) so L3 can close.

Ethan V.: Acknowledged. Perf bench is queued but the cluster bumped into a noisy neighbor and rerun got preempted. Im requeuing on isolated nodes and will post ETA by 18:00 UTC.

Nora L.: Eng lead here 9if A1 still blocked at 18:00 UTC we should consider a short-term config change that trades some throughput for stability. We can revert when benches are green.

Carla R.: Thanks Nora. Ravi 9can you attach the canary logs and the rollback snippet to PM-2026-256 so I can mark A2 as canary-passed in the digest?

Ravi S.: Done 9logs and rollback notes added to the postmortem doc. Link: PM-2026-256 (internal).

Maya K.: If A1 needs a temporary change, A3 alert thresholds might need a small tweak for lower mem cap traffic shape. Happy to adjust after Ethan confirms.

Ethan V.: Reran perf on isolated nodes; two quick passes. Merging and will roll to canary with rollback in place. ETA merge+canary: 2026-04-02 07:30 UTC. Added test notes to PR.

SRE Bot: :white_check_mark: Reminder cleared for A1 (ETA updated).

Carla R.: Status summary for L3 rollup: A2 -> canary-passed (Ravi) and ready for rollout notes, A3 -> verifying (Maya), A1 -> merged-rolling-to-canary (Ethan) ETA 2026-04-02, A4 -> unassigned. Who can take A4? 30-45m to write TL;DR + runbook link.

Maya K.: I can do A4 after verifying finishes, likely by 2026-04-03.

Carla R.: Great. Final note 9please @mention me if any of these slip tonight; I'll escalate to leads immediately. Thanks all :thumbsup:
